pages.text: Every player has a vault while they are online. SET_SECRET puts a secret into it, and a SECRET line reads it, like a constant. Only the owner of the sheet can use the vault, and only when they start the program themselves, e.g. with a button.

A persistent vault keeps secrets when you leave. CREATE_VAULT makes one, OPEN_VAULT opens it. Your game asks for the password, and only your game can open the file; the server keeps it, but can't read it.

$(1)PROGRAM keys$(br)NOOP$(br)INCLUDE c0de/security$(br)NOOP$(br)FUNCTION setup$(br)BEGIN$(br)  VARIABLE exists BOOLEAN$(br)  VARIABLE key STRING$(br)  CALL c0de/security/HAS_VAULT$(br)    RESULT result exists$(br)  IF exists ;$(br)  BEGIN$()

$(1)    CALL c0de/security/OPEN_VAULT$(br)  END$(br)  ELSE$(br)  BEGIN$(br)    CALL c0de/security/CREATE_VAULT$(br)  END IF$(br)  CALL INPUT$(br)    PARAMETER variable key ;$(br)    PARAMETER hide TRUE ;$(br)  CALL c0de/security/SET_SECRET$(br)    PARAMETER name "apiKey" ;$(br)    PARAMETER value key ;$()
Another program then reads the key with $(1)SECRET apiKey STRING$(), after OPEN_VAULT.
